name: FrameOS Gallery
description: Random image from the FrameOS gallery

fields.markdown: [Click here](https://gallery.frameos.net/) to see all the galleries.

fields.name: format
fields.label: Image format
fields.hint: jpg: the gallery scales the image to the area it is drawn in and sends a JPEG, a fraction of the bytes and the decoding of the original (recommended, every color kept). png: the same, lossless, about five times the bytes. original: the file as uploaded, scaled on the frame.

fields.name: fit
fields.label: Scale to the target
fields.hint: The gallery scales the image to the area it will be drawn in (the frame, or a split cell). auto follows the image node's placement; cover fills the area and crops the rest, contain keeps the whole image inside it. Neither upscales a small image.
